title: -Apply is refused on purpose: the read-only contract cannot be switched off
titleZh: -Apply 被刻意拒绝:只读契约无法被打开
why: The collector has no write path at all, and the acceptance for this suite requires that to stay true. -Apply must be accepted as a parameter (so a caller cannot think it worked) and then refused with a non-zero exit and a printed reason. This is the closest thing to a switch that could ever make the tool dangerous, so it is tested explicitly.
expectSummary: exit 2 and a REFUSED explanation on stdout
